title: Canonical Organisation identity refinement (ADR-BCP-027 / LA-01)
description: A v2 Organisation is a CP CanonicalEntity with its durable UUID identifier. This tightened v2 boundary prevents legal-entity first-party aliases such as ZURIBEANS/NABHOLD being used as organisation_id. It does not alter the legacy generic canonicalEntityId definition.

organisationId.description: Canonical Organisation UUID minted/attested by Control Plane. No first-party legal-entity ID, alias, brand or display name is a valid substitute.
